d:
When I’ve got a lot going on, I like to take my handpan into the woods. My mind is usually still on the day at first. Then I find a melody and get so caught up in it that I could play the same few notes for ages. I love that feeling.
If you have a few minutes today, I’d love for you to sit with me and try this. Find a position you can rest in and feel the weight of your body where it’s supported. Let your breath move at its own pace. Pick out one note and listen to it for as long as you can hear it. Then let the next one come to you.
